About

Hi, I'm Heena.

I'm a freelance model working with brands on fashion, lifestyle, real estate and product shoots. Send me a brief and I'll turn up ready for it.

This page is organised brand wise, so you can see the kind of work I do for each type of client before you book.

Services

What I shoot

Five kinds of shoots. The cards tilt as you scroll, and follow your pointer on a computer.

  • Modeling and campaigns

    Editorial, lifestyle and campaign shoots, in a studio, outdoors or on location.

    StudioOutdoorLifestyle

  • Clothing and fashion

    Lookbooks, catalogues and e-commerce shoots with quick outfit changes and clean poses.

    LookbookCatalogueReels

  • Jewellery

    Close-ups of ears, neck and hands, with soft expressions and steady poses.

    EarringsNecklacesRings

  • Product shoots

    Holding, using and styling products on camera for ads and packshots.

    BeautyFragranceDaily use

  • Real estate

    Natural, lived-in poses for flats, villas and showrooms.

    FlatsVillasShowrooms

Process

Booking in 4 steps

  1. 1

    Share the brief

    Brand, shoot type, date, city and any references you have.

  2. 2

    Lock date and look

    We confirm the schedule, outfits and styling notes.

  3. 3

    Shoot day

    I arrive on time and ready for the first frame.

  4. 4

    Wrap

    A quick look at the shots, then we plan the next one.
